title: Futur et conditionnel : will, would, if

lesson.x: En anglais, on exprime le futur avec will ou going to, et la condition avec if.
Futur simple : will + base verbale : I will help you. Négation : will not (won't). Question : Will you come ?
Be going to : projet ou prévision : I am going to study tonight. It is going to rain.
First conditional (condition réalisable) : If + present simple, will + base verbale : If it rains, we will stay at home.
Second conditional (condition imaginaire ou peu probable) : If + past simple, would + base verbale : If I had money, I would buy a car.
Pour le verbe be au second conditional, on emploie souvent were : If I were you, I would study.
Would sert aussi à formuler une demande polie : Would you like some tea ?
Marqueurs du futur : tomorrow, next week, soon, in two days, tonight.
Exemple : If you study, you will pass the exam. (condition réalisable)
Attention : après if on n'emploie pas will dans la proposition de condition.

questions.q: Comment forme-t-on le futur simple en anglais ?
Complète : Tomorrow, I ___ visit my aunt.
Quelle est la forme négative de « will » ?
questions.e: « Will not » se contracte en won't.

questions.q: Quelle question au futur est correcte ?
questions.e: On inverse will et le sujet.

o: I am going to study tonight.
questions.e: Be going to exprime une intention.

questions.q: Complète : It is cloudy. It ___ rain.
questions.e: Prévision basée sur ce qu'on voit.

questions.q: Complète : If it rains, we ___ at home.
questions.e: First conditional : if + présent, will + base.

questions.q: Complète : If you study, you ___ the exam.
Complète : If I had money, I ___ a car.
questions.e: Second conditional : if + past, would + base.

questions.q: Complète : If I ___ you, I would study.
questions.e: On emploie were dans les conseils.

questions.q: Quel auxiliaire sert à demander poliment ?
questions.e: « Would you like some tea? » est poli.

o: We will stay if it rains.
If it will rain, we will stay.
If it rains, we will stay.
questions.e: On n'emploie pas will après if.

questions.q: Quelle phrase est un first conditional ?
o: If you called me, I would answer.
If you had called me, I would have answered.
If you call me, I will answer.

questions.q: Quelle phrase est un second conditional ?
o: If I were rich, I would travel.
I travel when I am rich.
If I am rich, I will travel.
